name: Umbral Esquina
motion: Both legs of the corner telescope into their wall pockets (lead panel collects each next panel at the interlock), leg B 8 frames behind; 9 s clip Panels_Pocket_<size>, plus a short lead-panel slide on the flush-pull hotspot.
options: Size / layout (3 variants: two corners, one straight pocket)
Divided lites: Clear view / Steel-line grid

hotspots.title: Open the corner
hotspots.text: Both legs slide into their wall pockets. No post, no jamb, only air where the corner was.

hotspots.title: Flush pull
hotspots.text: A recessed pull sits in the lead stile, so the panel passes fully into the pocket. Pull it and it collects the next panel at the interlock.

hotspots.title: No post at 90°
hotspots.text: Two panels meet at the corner with no post or jamb. When both legs pocket, the corner is gone.

hotspots.title: 25 mm insulating glass
hotspots.text: Two 6 mm panes and a dark spacer, glazed into thermally broken frames. Claro, Satinado or Gris under Glass.

hotspots.title: The floor runs through
hotspots.text: The sill pan sits in the slab, so the floor is level inside and out. Only the stainless track inserts show.

hotspots.title: Thermally broken frame
hotspots.text: Every profile carries a polyamide thermal break. Where two panels meet, the interlock reads 64 mm.

hotspots.title: Open the wall
hotspots.text: Four panels stack into one wall pocket and leave the full 4.88 m clear.

hotspots.title: Lock stile
hotspots.text: The lead panel closes into the lock jamb on an 83 mm stile, with multi-point locking.

description: A corner with no post. Both legs slide into pockets in the walls, and the corner of the room opens to the terrace. Thermally broken aluminium, 25 mm insulating glass, a floor that runs straight through.
gaps: frame_depth_mm is per track (49 mm); a 3-panel leg runs three tracks.
Glass set is Claro, Satinado and Gris (grey tint, outside the BRAND glass list); no reeded or bronze pane in this model.
Width is per leg for the corner sizes (width_mm = both legs added).
Material names carry the product (account-unique names).
Hotspots on moving panels stay at their rest positions while the clip plays (platform behaviour).
Stills are Cycles renders of the source .blend with stills-only floor/wall extensions; the GLB itself is unchanged apart from renamed internal node and image names.
qa: Live QA 25 Nov: loads with Acero Grafito frame and 6 hotspots; "Open the corner" pockets both legs into the walls.
